Court Admissions & Jurisdiction

Supreme Court of Nepal High Court Patan (Commercial Bench) High Court Biratnagar Kathmandu District Court Special Court (Kathmandu) Nepal Council of Arbitration (NEPCA)

Professional Practice & Substantive Experience

With extensive courtroom experience spanning over a decade and a half, Senior Counsel has established a notable track record in high-stakes civil litigation, property title adjudication (Lalpurja and Anshabanda partition suits), and constitutional writ petitions. He regularly represents domestic corporations, foreign investors, and non-resident Nepalese (NRNs) in asset protection and complex commercial disputes.

Notable Contributions & Publications

  • Procedural Evolution of Injunctions under Muluki Civil Procedure Code 2074 (Nepal Bar Council Journal)
  • Corporate Governance & Fiduciary Liabilities in Closely Held Companies (Nepal Law Review)
  • Due Diligence Standards in Real Estate Acquisitions in Nepal (Commercial Law Journal)

Languages Spoken

English, Nepali (नेपाली), Bhojpuri, Hindi.

Consultation Availability

Consultations with Senior Counsel are scheduled strictly by appointment through the chambers registry to prevent conflicts of interest.
